The modification of a work of visual art which is a result of the passage of time or the inherent nature of the materials is not a distortion, mutilation, or other modification

forbidden_claims.claim: Selling a painting automatically waives the artist's rights of attribution and integrity.
The rights under section 106A last for 70 years after the author's death.
